Name: No New Game
Author: Huskyn1nja
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8]Modders across the world are constantly plagued by the incurable disease known as Restartitis. Now, With No New Game they can finally get past Spring (maybe. Probably not). This mod checks your game and if it detects any save files, it will gray out the New Game option and shame you if you choose to click on it.[/color]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332629.png[/img]
• Install the latest version of [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b].
• Go get some water (hydration is important)﻿
• Run the game using SMAPI and continue your farm for once. Geez.


[b][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332703.png[/img][/b]
[color=#d4d4d8]• There is a known issue where people swear and get mad at me because they want a new farm but this mod doesn't let them[/color]
• Note: Source code for this mod is available on my [url=https://github.com/Huskyn1nja/StardewValleyMods]Github[/url]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/13610770-1759332750.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Thank you to Lune for the idea for this mod.
• Description separators made via https://www.kdau.com/scrollish/ [/color]
